example_en: He suffers from back trouble too, so he was very sympathetic about my problem.
example_zh: 他自己也受背痛的困擾，所以對我的煩惱深表同情。

example_en: The president has sent a message of sympathy to the relatives of the dead soldiers.
example_zh: 總統已經向陣亡士兵的家屬發出弔唁電報。

example_en: He's complaining of all the usual flu symptoms - a high temperature, headache, and so on.
example_zh: 他抱怨所有常見的感冒癥狀——高燒、頭痛等，都出現在他身上。

example_en: The participants' employers sponsor them for the six-month training program.
example_zh: 參與者的雇主贊助他們參加為期六個月的培訓計畫。

example_en: I lost my younger brother to suicide.
example_zh: 我因自殺而失去了弟弟。
